BillHeading.BriefDescription: Funding certain programs that provide support to farms.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to funding certain programs that provide support to farms; and making an appropriation.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader:
Sec. 1.
The sum of one million dollars, or as much thereof as may be necessary, is appropriated for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2016, from the general fund to the department of agriculture for the purposes of revitalizing the department of agriculture's farm-to-school program, RCW 15.64.060, and the small farm direct marketing assistance program, RCW 15.64.050.
